body.x: MAXAERO(www.maxaero.com), a company dedicated to deliver ground-breaking solutions for new aerial exploration, unveiled GPS-enabled "X-star" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The X-star flight control system analyzes data from the built-in IMU enhanced GPS modules and multiple sensors automatically, presenting various optimal smart flight features. Supporting up to 800 grams payload, it is compatible with more than one gimbal models. It can fly at a maximum cruising speed of 12m per second for about 25 minutes flight time on a single full battery charge.Li-Ion battery is made robust and handy. The LED indicator panel displays real time flight status including GPS signal, battery level, and communication stabilities.
